metadata.title: feat: add multi-language license compliance checker with CI/CD
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Add `scripts/license_checker.py` — a comprehensive license policy checker that scans Python (pip + 24 sub-project venvs), Go, and Rust dependencies against a TOML-based policy
- Add `license-policy.toml` with allowed/disallowed SPDX patterns and per-package allowlist
- Add `license-check` Make target with configurable flags (`LICENSE_CHECK_SUMMARY_ONLY`, `LICENSE_CHECK_INCLUDE_DEV_GROUPS`)
- Add `.github/workflows/license-check.yml` CI workflow (push, PR, weekly schedule)

Closes #2939

### Key capabilities
- SPDX normalization pipeline (40+ regex rules for GPL/LGPL/AGPL/MPL/BSD/MIT variants)
- OR-expression semantics (e.g. `Apache-2.0 OR MIT` passes if any alternative is clean)
- Sub-venv discovery via `importlib.metadata` (zero extra dependencies)
- Full-text license body detection (MIT/BSD) for packages with missing SPDX metadata
- One-time regex compilation via `CompiledPatterns` dataclass
- JSON report output with per-scope stats

### Current results
- 0 errors, 5 warnings (go-licenses stdlib noise) across ~2,931 packages
- All 12,144 unit tests pass

## Test plan
- [ ] `make license-check` completes with 0 errors
- [ ] `LICENSE_CHECK_SUMMARY_ONLY=true make license-check` prints summary only
- [ ] JSON report generated at configured path
- [ ] CI workflow runs successfully on this PR
